name: deks-plugin
description: Operate DEKS from Cloud or Desktop, and design coherent, animated presentations with an opinionated method and a pattern catalogue.

interface.shortDescription: Build animated decks with the DEKS MCP.
interface.longDescription: Connect an agent to a DEKS presentation, in a cloud workspace or in a folder on this machine. Five skills keep the concerns apart: the document contract itself, the exact tool map of each host, an opinionated method for turning a subject into topics and narrations, and a catalogue of reusable choreographies — from promoting a list item into the next slide's title to a figure that counts as it arrives.
defaultPrompt: Create a coherent presentation in DEKS using the design methodology.
Improve the layout and motion of my DEKS deck.
Audit my presentation's story, palette, layout, and transitions.
